theorems.name: Submission.rsod_tv_meanCurvature
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' U)), W.weight = V.weight.map (fun y => y - x₀) → (∀ y, W.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + x₀)) → ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → W.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun y => H (y + x₀))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
